readmeExcerpt: Mardara Expense Tracker Track Your Money. Control Your Future. A responsive, full-stack personal finance application built for beginners with Node.js, Express, SQLite, HTML, CSS and Vanilla JavaScript. Features - Secure registration/login with bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication - Private per-user income and expense records - Create, edit, delete, search and combine transaction filters - Monthly dashboard: income, expense, balance, budget, remaining budget, category breakdown - Monthly budgets with safe upsert behavior - User profile and password change - CSV export containing only the logged-in user's data - Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layout, loading/empty states and notifications Tech stack Node.js runs the server. Express provides REST APIs. SQLite is the local database through better-sqlite3. The browser UI uses HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript and Fetch API. Ins

Adjust tools/verify.mjs if Chrome is elsewhere. No browser download is required. Production output is in dist/; serve that directory with any static web host. No publishing has been performed.
